title: Ali ke noor ka sadqa dikhai deta hai
body:
Ali ke noor ka sadqa dikhai deta hai
Ali ke noor ka sadqa dikhai deta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke ghar mein ujaala dikhai deta hai
Ali ke noor ka sadqa dikhai deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Mizaaje nahje balagha hai aayato'n jaisa..(2)
kalaam ye bhi khuda ka dikhai deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Nuseri kehte hai mabood mere maula ko..(2)
ajeeb jhooth hai, sachha dikhai deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali imam e man asto manam ghulam e ali..(2)
har ek nabi yehi kehta dikhai deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Talaq duniya ko di jisne be niyazi se..(2)
wo sirf shauhar e zehra dikhai deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai jurm naam e ali lena, kya qayamat hai..(2)
tamaam shehr hi kufa dikhai deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kamaal e qudrat e mabood hai mera abbas..(2)
Ali ko bhi ye ali sa dikhai deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Najaf hai meer takallum ka toor aye musa..(2)
use yehi pe wo jalwa dikhai deta hai
author: Muqtar Hussain
